assignments.node_id: מי שזוכה ללמד להשכינה, שלמודו עולה להשכינה
assignments.reason: This node describes 'one who merits to study Torah for the Shekhinah, whose study ascends to the Shekhinah.' Its essential nature is the human side of the Shekhinah-as-intermediary relationship: the person whose Torah study is directed toward and ascends to the Shekhinah. The concept is defined entirely in terms of the Shekhinah — it is the act of engaging the Shekhinah as intermediary. This places it squarely in Package 1 (שְׁכִינָה וְאֶמְצָעִי), which captures the Torah's foundational premise that the Shekhinah is the intermediary between human beings and God. Polarity good: directing one's Torah study to the Shekhinah is the ideal, holy form of learning described in this Torah.

assignments.node_id: שכינה, מקבלת הלמוד התורה ומעלה להשם יתברך, ונמשך מזה שפע, הינו שפע רוחניות ושפע גשמיות
assignments.reason: This node describes the Shekhinah in its active mediating role: receiving Torah study, elevating it to God, and channeling the resulting shefa (spiritual and material abundance) back down. While the node mentions שפע רוחניות and שפע גשמיות (which belong to Package 2 as bechina concepts), the essential nature of this node is the Shekhinah functioning as intermediary — receiving, elevating, and transmitting. The shefa is mentioned as the consequence of the Shekhinah's mediating activity, not as the node's defining identity. The node's subject is the Shekhinah (הַשְּׁכִינָה מְקַבֶּלֶת... וּמַעֲלָה...), making Package 1 the correct assignment by essential nature. Polarity good: the Shekhinah's mediation producing divine abundance is entirely within the holy domain.
